title: SQLite schema v3 projection tables and migration
description: Objective: raise the durable schema to v3 with the four tables a projection/outbox subsystem needs, and a migration the exact-schema validator accepts. Task A of a 2-way split of task-50874e67, which architect-d89636d1 blocked as unplannable at 14 files against a 10-file cap with a self-contradictory DoD. Deliverable: schema manifest carrying a SCHEMA_V2 snapshot plus four new tables (no AUTOINCREMENT), an intermediate moe-sqlite-schema/2 constant, and a two-leg migration. Known constraint found during blocking analysis, do not rediscover it: ALTER splices sqlite_schema text and the result can never match the exact validator, so the migration must recreate domain_events on empty rather than ALTER it. NOT in scope: the StoredEvent domainSchemaVersion field, the EventLedgerStore commit seam, PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED, or any projection logic — all of that is Task B (StoredEvent domain schema version and projection commit seam) and must have somewhere to land. Hard dependencies: none; builds on task-9e3faf3b (commit 9e16dde) which split sqlite-schema.ts by conformance/integrity/migration/bootstrap. Owned paths: packages/store/src/sqlite-schema*.ts, packages/store/src/store-internals.ts, the schema-version constant in packages/store/src/store-contracts.ts, one new migration test, and the two version-pin test edits named in the DoD. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Schema v3 adds the four projection/inbox/subscription/cursor-generation tables with no AUTOINCREMENT, and the exact-schema validator accepts a migrated database as conformant rather than rejecting added objects.

The migration runs as two legs through the intermediate moe-sqlite-schema/2 constant, recreates domain_events on empty rather than using ALTER, and refuses a populated or newer database with its existing stable codes.

Existing tests pass with ONLY the version-literal updates the new schema forces: command-decision-integrity.test.ts (userVersion pin) and store-project-and-schema-contract.test.ts (the too-new tamper, which must be re-pointed above v3 rather than deleted). No test is weakened, skipped, or loosened beyond those literals.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0 and only explicitly owned paths are staged and committed.
taskRails: Do not touch StoredEvent, the commit seam, or PROJECTION_APPLY_FAILED. Those belong to Task B; implementing them here rebuilds the oversized task that was just split.
The exact-schema validator must be updated to EXPECT the new tables. Never weaken it, bypass it, or make it permissive about unknown objects.

The two permitted test edits are version literals only. Re-point the too-new tamper above v3; do not delete the case, and do not treat 'existing tests pass unchanged' as license to edit anything else.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400. Commit by explicit pathspec only.
reopenReason: Governor: requeueing — this is the single highest-unlock task available and its dependencies are met. SQLite schema decomposition is DONE (commit 9e16dde) and gave it the conformance/integrity/migration/bootstrap seam to build against. It gates the entire projection chain: StoredEvent commit seam, pure upcaster engine, transactional relay, subscription cursors, and crash/rebuild hardening — five tasks, none of which can start until schema v3 lands. Blocking-analysis findings are already in the description so they are not rediscovered: ALTER splices sqlite_schema text and can never match the exact validator, so the migration recreates domain_events on empty through an intermediate moe-sqlite-schema/2 constant.

comments.content: DoD amendment (announced, not silently exceeded): verification found a THIRD test pinning the schema version — sqlite-event-store-core.test.ts:26 `expect(health.userVersion).toBe(2)` inside the fresh-store safety test. It fails the moment SCHEMA_VERSION goes 3 and is exactly the forced-version-literal class the DoD's two named edits cover; it was simply missed in enumeration. The plan includes it as a one-literal edit (2 -> 3), nothing else in that file. Also for QA clarity: the store-project-and-schema-contract.test.ts permitted edit spans TWO paired literals in ONE test (line 65 tamper 3 -> 4 AND lines 85-86 asserted user_version 3 -> 4 — the refusal path persists the tampered value). Literals that must NOT change (frozen v1 semantics): command-decision-integrity.test.ts:268-269/:275, command-decision-test-helpers.ts:123-125 frozen v1 fixture, sqlite-event-store-core.test.ts:74-75/:103.

blockedReason: The task cannot satisfy its own exact verification gate under the current ownership and test-edit rail. Raising PRAGMA user_version from 2 to 3 necessarily makes packages/store/src/sqlite-event-store-core.test.ts:26 fail (`expect(health.userVersion).toBe(2)`), but the task permits version-literal edits only in command-decision-integrity.test.ts and store-project-and-schema-contract.test.ts and does not own sqlite-event-store-core.test.ts. Repo-wide audit found this is the only additional current-version pin. Required amendment: add packages/store/src/sqlite-event-store-core.test.ts to owned paths and permit only line 26's literal 2→3; no assertion weakening. Without that amendment, either the focused gate fails or the worker violates explicit rails.
